from glom.core import glom
from glom.mutation import assign

target = {'users': [{'name': 'Ada', 'score': 3}, {'name': 'Bob', 'score': 5}, {'name': 'Cy', 'score': 8}]}
names = glom(target, ('users', ['name']))
assign(target, 'summary.names', names, missing=dict)
assign(target, 'summary.count', len(names), missing=dict)

print(names)
print(target['summary'])
print(target)
